title: Artifact
description: An immutable derived result (D9): a transcript, OCR text, summary, rendition or overlay. Rerunning a job makes a new Artifact; the Hub owns which one is current per (subject_ref, artifact_type). It can be rerun from the recorded inputs, but the result may differ, so it is backed up. The body is the content Blob; its structure (blocks and refs) arrives with #8 (E20). Its effective cloud_policy is min of its inputs, computed at each provider call and not stored (D8). The Hub writes every column. Open: clients ignore members they do not know.

artifact_type.description: Known types are the examples; a newer Hub may send others, which a client keeps but does not interpret.

subject_ref.description: What the Artifact was made for.

job_key.description: The ProcessingJob's job_key (D4) as lowercase hex SHA-256: the same key reuses this Artifact.

provider.description: The provider that ran the model; absent for a job without one, such as a rendition.

model.description: The model; absent for a job without one.

prompt_version.description: The prompt's version; absent for a job without a prompt.

input_hashes.description: SHA-256 of every input: Blobs, and other Artifacts by their content Blob.
